name: Scroll Fan Carousel
description: Scroll-driven 3D card carousel where a stack of image cards fans out in perspective and falls away one by one as the user scrolls through a pinned viewport.
contents: Stack of image cards, each with category label and title over a dark gradient
Animated scroll cue arrow at the bottom of the screen
behavior: Cards enter with an intro animation, then scrolling scrubs them through a 3D fall-away timeline
Viewport is pinned with ScrollTrigger while the tall wrapper scrolls
Cards are grayscale and turn to color on hover
Scroll arrow loops a stroke animation and fades out after the first scroll
editableByProps: Number of cards, titles, categories and images
Perspective depth, card max size and total scroll length

needsCodeEdit.where: grayscale class on the carousel-card div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fan and fall motion
needsCodeEdit.where: The timeline built with transformOrigin and stagger tweens on .carousel-card

fixed: Takes over page scrolling: a tall wrapper pins the viewport with ScrollTrigger and scrubs the animation
Scroll cue arrow is fixed to the bottom of the screen
Renders nothing until mounted on the client
Card size is 65% by 75% of the viewport up to the max size props
